resources.string:
Phase 4 — voice loop with spoken replies.

Tap Start and speak English. When you pause, your turn goes to the LLM (stubbed) and a Japanese reply streams back AND is spoken aloud (Android system TTS) for shadowing:

 You: …your speech…
 JA: …Japanese reply (spoken)…

Replies are canned until you plug in a real LLM. Turn up the emulator volume!
